label: Phase 2 — Interactive Codegen (iter 1, cold)
summary: Full cold codegen of chemical_detector: two controllers (GasAnalysisController, MovementController), shared events turn/stop/resume, Vehicle sensing/actuation surface, Clock-based stuck detection.

issues.title: No Final mode in either controller
issues.detail: Spec final states modelled as live modes Located/Found with event-triggered self-loops; terminating events (stop, flag) still emitted. Required by the Isabelle theory generator's no-Final constraint (CLAUDE.md).

issues.title: Vehicle operations are actuator methods
issues.detail: CD-OP1..4 are methods on actuator.Vehicle, not operation/ compute() classes, because the spec defines them as Vehicle-provided actuation primitives.

issues.title: during randomWalk() encoded as top-of-mode statement
issues.detail: CD-MV-FR1's during action has no direct Java encoding; top-of-Waiting-block vehicle.randomWalk() is the supported approximation.

issues.title: analysis() classifies on chemical identity only
issues.detail: gasD iff some reading's c equals the target chem; spec does not define 'indicates the target chemical' precisely.

issues.title: Safe defaults for empty readings
issues.detail: intensity() returns 0.0, location() returns Front when the reading is empty.

issues.title: All constants = 1
issues.detail: THR, LV, EVADE_TIME, STUCK_PERIOD, STUCK_DIST, OUT_PERIOD all 1 to fit FDR4 type ranges {0..1}.

issues.title: Intensity = real, Chem = record(nat id)
issues.detail: Spec leaves both opaque; equality/ordering only.

issues.title: Odometer is a sensor method, not a trigger
issues.detail: Spec only reads odometer inside actions (odometer ? d0), so it is a zero-arg sensor method assigned in transition actions.

next_step: Run the pipeline (compile through vacuity) and iterate from post_* feedback.
